verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published OpenAPI spec (lium.io/api/openapi.json, usable for type generation), raw-markdown docs and an MCP server for searching docs. None of these is an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples: the spec is a developer building block and doc search is an adjacent feature. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger explorer at the docs domain, and nothing documents an in-browser API console or executable request examples.
